venue: Azul Lounge at Fontainebleau Las Vegas

zones.label: Section 101
zones.description: Section 101 sits on the left as you face the stage, with rows A–E running from front to back. Choose the front for a closer look at the performers or sit farther back for a broader view.

zones.label: Section 102
zones.description: Section 102 sits on the right as you face the stage, with rows A–F running from front to back. Seats toward the center aisle give you a more central angle; the outer edge offers a side perspective.

zones.label: Table 1
zones.description: Table 1 is behind Section 101 on the left side of the room. It offers table seating with a left-side perspective across the stage.

zones.label: Table 2
zones.description: Table 2 sits behind Section 101, closer to the middle of the room. It offers table seating with a broader view from the rear and a more central angle than Table 1.

zones.label: Table 3
zones.description: Table 3 sits behind Section 102, closer to the middle of the room. It offers table seating with a broader view from the rear and a more central angle than Table 4.

zones.label: Table 4
zones.description: Table 4 is behind Section 102 on the right side of the room. It offers table seating with a right-side perspective across the stage.
